title: Biblical Measure, Cord, Path, Boundary & Reachability Atlas
purpose: Extend the leash/timeline/fate wave through a fresh biblical sweep of measuring lines, lots, cords, straight/level ways, burdens, races, walls, gates and spacious/narrow places. Preserve the textual meanings before any mathematical comparison.
epistemic_rule: Biblical geometry is literary, architectural, legal, poetic, covenantal and theological. Control theory, topology, graph theory and mechanics are later comparators. Similar structure is not proof that biblical authors encoded modern mathematics or Potatoverse cosmology.

clusters.structure: Creation is described through foundation, dimensions, a stretched measuring line and cornerstone imagery, while the sons of God/morning stars rejoice.
clusters.project_value: Measurement enters before moral judgment: line can mean specification/order rather than leash or punishment.
clusters.science_neighbor: geometry, dimensional specification, reference frame and boundary conditions

clusters.structure: The Lord is portion/cup; lot is upheld; lines or boundary/measuring lines fall in pleasant places; inheritance is good/beautiful.
clusters.project_value: Lot/destiny language and boundary geometry coexist without boundary being negative. Allocation, inheritance and measured region form a distinct fate/boundary operator.
clusters.science_neighbor: partition/allocation of a feasible region; not probability unless a specific lot-casting mechanism is being studied

clusters.structure: Zion foundation/cornerstone language is followed by justice as measuring line and righteousness as plumb line, while a false refuge is swept away.
clusters.project_value: Measure can be evaluative/normative rather than merely descriptive; the standard tests a construction/refuge.
clusters.science_neighbor: measurement against a reference/criterion; metric is not identical with the thing measured

clusters.structure: A man measures Jerusalem's width/length; the city is then described as inhabited without walls because of abundance, with the Lord as a wall of fire around it and glory within.
clusters.project_value: One of the strongest Door/House/Shell corrections: measurement does not imply confinement, and protection does not require an ordinary material wall.
clusters.science_neighbor: measurement/observation distinct from actuation; virtual/functional boundary distinct from material barrier

clusters.structure: Restoration visions repeatedly measure sacred architecture; Revelation measures city, gates and wall and states equal length, width and height.
clusters.project_value: The Bible's culminating sacred-city geometry prevents cube/foursquare geometry from being assigned an intrinsic shadow/evil valence.
clusters.science_neighbor: explicit dimensional geometry; sacred interpretation remains theological

clusters.structure: Iniquity/sin is portrayed as something drawn or dragged with cords/ropes, including cart-rope imagery.
clusters.project_value: Strong parallel to leash plus millstone/burden/path-cost: the subject carries or drags the burden rather than merely being externally tethered.
clusters.science_neighbor: accumulated load/path cost comparator only; sin is not mechanical mass

clusters.structure: Cords/ropes of death/Sheol encompass or entangle; snares of death confront the speaker.
clusters.project_value: Cord + encirclement + snare appear together as a negative constraint field, complementing Dog-circle/snares without equating the images.

clusters.structure: Cords/bands of human kindness/love are associated with leading, easing the yoke and feeding.
clusters.project_value: Cord is not intrinsically captivity. Guidance can increase capability while reducing burden.
clusters.science_neighbor: support/control relation with positive capability effect, not literal tension

clusters.structure: The passage concerns companionship/mutual support and concludes that a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
clusters.project_value: Useful resilience comparator for distributed support, but the text is about companionship rather than topology or a hidden Trinity proof.
clusters.science_neighbor: redundant paths/load sharing/network connectivity; correlated failure caution

clusters.structure: A race/course is set before the community; hindrance/weight and entangling sin are laid aside; the race is run with endurance and orientation toward Jesus.
clusters.project_value: Exceptionally dense trajectory cluster: path, burden, entanglement, endurance, witness field, orientation and target appear together.
clusters.science_neighbor: trajectory + path cost + obstacles/constraints + reference target; theological meaning is not reduced to optimization

clusters.structure: Paths for the feet are to be considered/made level or straight; Hebrews explicitly connects straight/level paths with preventing further disability and enabling healing.
clusters.project_value: Path geometry can be capability infrastructure: improving the route helps a vulnerable traveler rather than simply commanding greater effort.
clusters.science_neighbor: accessibility, path tortuosity, obstacle reduction, robust control and environmental accommodation

clusters.structure: Wisdom/guidance language uses straight paths, avoidance of harmful ways and a voice directing the traveler when turning right or left.
clusters.project_value: Direction can be guided without being mechanically forced; guidance, choice and course correction coexist.
clusters.science_neighbor: feedback guidance / path planning; no claim of literal control algorithm

clusters.structure: Distress/tightness is answered with freedom or a broad/spacious place; an enlarged heart/understanding accompanies running the commanded path.
clusters.project_value: Broadness can mean release and increased capability, which directly corrects any universal equation broad=destructive based on Matthew 7.
clusters.science_neighbor: expanded feasible/reachable region or capability set

clusters.structure: Wide gate/broad way is associated with destruction while narrow gate/way is associated with life.
clusters.project_value: Width receives a negative valence here because of destination/outcome, not because width is geometrically evil.
clusters.science_neighbor: route capacity/width requires an objective; geometry alone cannot determine value

measurement_operator_taxonomy: urban/restoration survey without ordinary wall confinement — Zechariah 2
cord_operator_taxonomy: loving guidance and eased yoke — Hosea 11
major_new_findings: Measurement is not control. Biblical measuring lines can specify, allocate, evaluate or survey without functioning as a tether.
Boundary is not necessarily material. Zechariah 2 explicitly pairs measurement with a wall-less city and a different protective boundary image.
Width has no fixed moral sign. Matthew 7's broad destructive way and Psalm 118's broad rescue-space must be held together.
Cord has no fixed moral sign. It can signify sin/death, guidance/love, self-binding or resilience.
Straight/level path is not only private moral purity; Hebrews 12:13 makes path design relevant to healing and vulnerability, giving the project an accessibility/capability reading.

The Bible contains a recurring measure/foundation/city architecture: creation measurement (Job), Zion foundation and justice-line (Isaiah), Jerusalem measurement without ordinary walls (Zechariah), measured temple (Ezekiel), measured final city/gates/walls (Revelation). Treat this as a textual-structural cluster, not a hidden modern engineering code.

Revelation 21 provides a decisive anti-flattening control for cube symbolism: equal length/width/height belongs to a positive holy-city image, so cube/foursquare geometry cannot be intrinsically shadow.
